description: This file contains functions that interact with a backend API to fetch user analytics data, including tenant user summaries and referral sources. It includes helper functions for request parameter normalization and handles API responses and errors.

methods.name: normalizeQuery(params = {})
methods.description: Helper function to build a clean query object by converting Date instances to ISO strings, handling string dates, and removing undefined/null/empty string values.

methods.name: getTenantUsersSummary(params = {})
methods.description: Fetches a summary of tenant users with optional filtering parameters; handles API errors and returns normalized response data.

methods.name: getReferralSources(params = {})
methods.description: Fetches referral source data with optional filtering, including limiting the number of results; handles errors and normalizes response data.
